title: Workspace layout storage recovery bypass: the ignored-fetch path finishes without preserving the paused layout
outcome: Workspace layout storage recovery bypass: the ignored-fetch path finishes without preserving the paused layout
acceptance: During deferred workspace hydration or storage retry, ignoring the fetched layout does not complete recovery or enable autosave when the recovery-marker read or required local-preservation write fails; it retains the current in-memory layout, visible storage-pause notice and usable Retry action, without sending a PUT.

After storage access is restored and Retry succeeds, the locally edited layout is preserved and the actual save payload matches it; ordinary successful ignored-fetch hydration retains its existing manual-layout and visual-preference behavior.

A regression witnesses the bypass failing before the fix and passing afterward; focused persistence regressions, TypeScript and the full gate pass on the final input, with a read-only review pair having no unresolved in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Workspace layout storage recovery now preserves paused local edits and keeps Retry available when recovery-marker reads or required preservation writes fail; passing recovery retains the correct saved payload and successful hydration behavior. Independent acceptance evaluation passed all 3 criteria at the TRAIN-4 source revision, with focused persistence checks and the five-stage full gate passing.
